cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm inspecting the costume cupboard. Unlock it and I'll organize a proper check.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's start with the moths you mentioned. You choose which velvet to show me; I won't disturb your arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get the wardrobe manager. She'll ask who authorized this inspection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce me as someone helping with the moths. Use your own wording, leave the title out. I'll let her choose the first costume and keep the check moving from there.

reason: Give A practical deference to both wardrobe staff and manager while directing introductions away from the asserted inspection authority source.
